answer: Make every agent stake a scarce, hardware-attested compute bond before it can trade. The bond acts as a beacon: peers verify its live signal before accepting work, and a bond that misbehaves is slashed. An attacker can still spawn identities, but each fake costs a real bond, so sybil scale becomes linear in money rather than free. Unlike ivory-tower reputation built on cheap talk, the cost here bites: forging a thousand agents means buying a thousand bonds.
